Vial label · print spec

ZUMA Tides · wrap label for the 3 mL vial (Option C: plain clear vial, Oxblood cap) · twelve SKUs · Rev 3 · 3 Nov 2026 (NAD+ moves to the 10 mL vial and its larger label; Rev 2: KLOW 80 mg, BAC water label)

The label

Size43.0 × 20.0 mm trim, corners rounded 1.0 mm. Wraps a Ø 16 mm vial with a 7 mm gap at the back. Except 03 BAC water and 08 NAD+: 65.0 × 30.2 mm trim (the same design scaled ×1.51, bleed 2.3 mm, page 69.5 × 34.8 mm) for the standard 10 mL vial, Ø 24 mm, 10 mm gap at the back.
Bleed1.5 mm all round. Each print file is a 46 × 23 mm page with the bleed built in; no crop marks.
Safe area1.0 mm inside the trim. Nothing that matters sits outside it.
MaterialWhite polypropylene film (BOPP), permanent acrylic adhesive rated for −20 °C storage, matte laminate. Must hold through freezer storage, condensation and an alcohol wipe.
PrintDigital CMYK, full bleed, one design per SKU. No white ink, no spot colours.
ColourMatch the hex values below. Oxblood #6E1C2A is the brand colour on every label: hard proof it before the run.
Lot boxThe white box top-left (LOT, 11.3 × 3.4 mm) stays blank for the lot number: inkjet or thermal transfer at filling. If thermal transfer, order the laminate as TT-receptive.
QR code9.6 mm, one fixed code per product (the same on every vial of it), linking to that product's lot reports (zumatides.com/lots#CODE-). Scan the proof before approving.
SupplyRolls for an applicator (76 mm core, one across, 3 mm gap; confirm unwind direction with the applicator) or sheets for hand labelling. Order vials + 10% per SKU for set-up and spoilage.

On the vial

  • Placement: bottom edge 3.0 mm above the base of the vial; the ZUMA logo and product name centred on the front; the gap at the back.
  • Cap: 13 mm flip-off, Oxblood #6E1C2A, on every SKU; silver aluminium crimp; grey butyl lyophilization stopper.
  • Vial: 3 mL clear borosilicate, Ø 16 mm, 35 mm tall with the cap, 13 mm crimp neck.

Colours

Oxblood #6E1C2A · Coral #FF6A55 (Dermal) · Lemon #F4D63A (Endocrine) · Lime #6CC93A (Tissue) · Sky #36B3E8 (Metabolic) · Lilac #A57BF0 (Neuro). Each label also uses the light tint of its colour for the top band; the files carry the exact values.

To confirm before ordering

  • Lot coding: who prints the lot number in the box, and how (inkjet or thermal transfer).
  • Bacteriostatic water (03) and NAD+ (08): labels sized for a standard 10 mL vial (Ø 24 mm, straight wall about 35 mm). Confirm against the real vial.
  • Quantities per SKU, and rolls or sheets.

Research use

Every label carries: For laboratory research use only. Not for human or veterinary use. Keep it on every reprint.
